ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(Credit_Card_Token__c) && $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator' && $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Administrator' && $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - Freight' && $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - QCC' && $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - SND' && RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Credit_Card_Recovery' && ( UPPER(Credit_Card_Token__c) <> Credit_Card_Token__c || LEN(Credit_Card_Token__c) > 16 || LEN(Credit_Card_Token__c) < 10 || CONTAINS(Credit_Card_Token__c, 'XXX') || NOT(REGEX(Credit_Card_Token__c, '^[0-9][A-Z0-9]+$') ) || NOT( REGEX(Credit_Card_Token__c, ".*[A-Z].*")) || NOT(REGEX(Credit_Card_Token__c, ".*[0-9].*")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Credit Card Token must contain only Uppercase characters and Credit Card Token Length can not be more than 16 characters
